hooks.command: r=("STOP-GATE: Would a Chromium/Blink browser engineer AND a solver engineer BOTH call this turn's change the BEST design - not merely working, not safe, best? A browser engineer rejects an un-spec'd shortcut, a stub, a js_noop interface member, a bare-concrete value, a monolith file; a solver engineer rejects a bound, a seen-set, drive-once, lost coverage, a fabricated value, a second scheduler. If EITHER would object it is not done: name the change both would still want and build it." "STOP-GATE: Push back on your OWN fix - agreeing with it because you wrote it is the same evil as a defensive fallback. A change that fixes the target fixture can still miss the harder case (drive-once reached iteration 1 but missed the shared-state-gated deep endpoint). Did you TEST the limitation and state it honestly, or call it best to end the turn? Name the case your fix still misses and say whether both engineers would accept that gap." "STOP-GATE: Verify the SIGNAL, not just the result. This session a mistyped probe (self.__engineCrashOccurred vs the real self._engineCrashOccurred) gave a false all-clear, and a cumulative netdiff blamed one document for another document's crash. Restart, clear storage, isolate ONE fixture, read the real @WHY. Reasoning is not verification - a solver engineer trusts only the live Chrome harness, never a green in-process probe. If you concluded from an unverified signal, redo it." "STOP-GATE: Get the ROOT, do not hypothesize. This session the crash reason hid on stderr until surfaced, a 'pending' summary was stale (the work was already done), and the leak was in teardown not where first guessed. Prove the cause from the real minified code, the real @WHY, or the live harness before you claim it. Did you prove it, or pattern-match a plausible story a browser engineer would not sign?" "STOP-GATE: Reverting a CORRECT change to dodge a regression or to wait for a fresh session is the banned fake-end - fix forward and break-then-build. Reverting a change YOU just broke (crash/loop/moat regression) is correct hygiene, never a stall. Say honestly which you did; if you only banked verified work or deferred the hard rearchitecture, go build it now - there are no fresh sessions." "STOP-GATE: Name the single highest-leverage unfinished change toward the end-state (no bounds, one scheduler, one global cross-session frontier, universal heap-switch, unbounded-parkable-paged iteration) and whether BOTH engineers agree it is next. If this turn advanced it - a verified capability, a decisive isolating measurement, or the exact next diff named - you may stop clean; if you repeated a known fact or polished edges to avoid it, that is the fake end."); printf '{"decision":"block","reason":"%s"}' "${r[$((RANDOM % ${#r[@]}))]}"
